title: A quasi-compact locally closed subset with retrocompact complement in a nice basis is constructible

standard_prerequisites.name: The notions of a retrocompact subset and of a constructible subset, and the hypothesis that the space has a basis of quasi-compact opens closed under finite intersections
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's section on constructible sets, immediately before the counted statement
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the hypotheses on the space and on the subset, and the conclusion.

core_obligations: Write the subset through the basis: since the subset is quasi-compact and open in its closure, the proof writes it as the intersection of its closure with a quasi-compact open coming from the assumed basis (proof lines 3021-3023).

The complement inside that open is retrocompact: the author shows that the difference between the chosen quasi-compact open and the subset is retrocompact in that open, using that the complement of the subset is retrocompact (proof lines 3023-3027).
Assembly: writing the subset as the complement of a retrocompact piece inside a quasi-compact open gives a constructible expression for it, which is the conclusion (proof lines 3027-3030).
Conclusion: the subset is constructible (proof line 3030).
proof_roadmap: 由 T 准紧且在其闭包中开，用假设的准紧开基把 T 写成 U ∩ cl(T)，其中 U 准紧开。
再证 V = U \ T 在 U 中 retrocompact（用 T 的补在 X 中 retrocompact），于是 T 有 constructible 的表达式，故 constructible。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is a criterion for constructibility of a locally closed subset (author lemma at source lines 3010-3018, label lemma-locally-closed-constructible-image): in a space with a basis of quasi-compact opens closed under finite intersections, a quasi-compact locally closed subset whose complement is retrocompact is constructible. The proof (source lines 3020-3030) uses the basis hypothesis in an essential way to write the subset as the intersection of its closure with a quasi-compact open (proof lines 3021-3023), and then reduces the constructibility to the retrocompactness of the difference inside that open (proof lines 3023-3027), which is where the hypothesis on the complement enters. H2.
